Name: Sea Cave
Author: dedpeech
Description:
Have you ever wanted to live in a cave? Or perhaps, take a cave nap? Well now you can without Harvey charging you. This mod adds a sea cave in a second large rock off the east pier. You MUST fix the wooden bridge, or have the no clip mod, or swim mod to access this location. 

This mod is the home of my [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/43386]NPC Sirona[/url], but you can also just enjoy this fun little location you can have naps in 💖 

This should work with all beach events, but do make sure to let me know, and to post your smapi log as I'm still new to modding! This is very likely to contain mistakes, but as I learn more I will fix them. 

Thank you for showing interest! 🫶
